sectionHeader.label: Who We Are
sectionHeader.subtitle: A full-service creative growth studio for ambitious Indian brands.

story.heading: Marketing that feels like art.
story.paragraph1: BRANDD-AID was born from a simple frustration: most marketing looks the same. We set out to prove that strategic thinking and beautiful craft aren't mutually exclusive.
story.paragraph2: Founded in 2019, we've grown into a full-service creative growth studio trusted by ambitious brands across India.

mission.heading: To make brands impossible to ignore.
mission.text: We exist to help ambitious brands build a presence that commands attention — through strategic creativity, disciplined execution, and a genuine obsession with results.

vision.heading: India's most trusted creative growth partner.
vision.text: We're building a studio that India's best brands choose not because we're the cheapest, but because we're the best — and because we genuinely care about their success.

values.title: Craft First
values.desc: Great work is the best business strategy. Quality is non-negotiable.

values.title: Relentlessly Fast
values.desc: Speed is a competitive advantage. We move quickly without sacrificing quality.

values.title: Radically Honest
values.desc: We'll tell you what you need to hear, not just what you want to hear.

values.title: Partner Mentality
values.desc: We treat your brand like it's ours. Long-term relationships, not transactions.
